title: Relationships
tagline: Build relationships naturally and organically in a world where every character is unique
description:
Relationships allows you to establish and build relationships in a way that feels natural and organic in a SkyrimNet-driven world. Every character has a unique combination of traits and attributes that make them behave and react to you in their own way.

Some characters fall deeply in love but want to save themselves for marriage, while others shun commitment but are DTF with no strings attached. Getting to know them and treating them accordingly is the whole point, just as in real life. Settings give you control over how quickly relationships progress. Relationships can also regress as warranted.

This applies to both romantic and platonic relationships. Deciding to progress to a romantic relationship requires mutual consent. A successful marriage proposal requires progressing to the highest tier.

Optionally integrates with its companion mod Kinship, so your significant other(s) and children are aware of their relationships to one another and act accordingly. Settings can ensure that your children are blocked from having romantic relations but can still grow their platonic bond.

Requires:
- SkyrimNet Beta 25+
- Meridian UI (
- SKSE and Address Library

Optionally supports:
- Kinship ( for awareness of familial ties )
- M.A.R.A.S. ( for marriage )
- OStim Community Resource ( for attractiveness rating )
- SeverActions ( for custom bio blocks )

Contains no adult content, though it can gate access to adult content provided by other mods depending on relationship status.
author: deadohiosky
changelog:
**Biggest change since the initial launch!**

Relationships no longer requires or depends on Romantasy. It keeps its own bonds now. If you're upgrading from Relationships 1.x, keep Romantasy installed for your first load: your bonds are brought over once automatically, and after that Romantasy is optional. If you decide to remove Romantasy after that, an optional Romantasy Stub is provided that lets saves that listed it keep loading while disabling its functionality.

**Other changes include:**
- New UI using Meridian UI
- NPCs no longer have to be followers/companions to be enrolled and tracked
- Enroll any NPC via hotkey or UI
- Your hotkeys need setting again - now with SkyrimNet's key picker and a modifier each, under Hotkeys in the plugin's settings in the SkyrimNet UI
